title: AMOS - AI Powered CRM System
description:
AMOS is an AI-augmented CRM that compresses weeks of repetitive sales work into minutes. It handles the full top-of-funnel cycle — maintaining ongoing client conversations and automating personalized lead discovery, outreach, and cold calls — so teams can spend their time closing rather than on busywork.

Under the hood it is built as a microservices architecture spanning Python and Go services, with a JavaScript/Node.js and TailwindCSS frontend and a PostgreSQL data layer, deployed on AWS. Large language models from OpenAI and Google Gemini power its conversational and lead-generation features, while Twilio drives the automated voice and messaging outreach.

title: Linkea Propeidades - Whatsapp Automated Concierge to CRM
description:
Linkea Propiedades is an end-to-end solution for a real-estate agency in Spain, centred on a WhatsApp concierge that handles client inquiries and guides prospective buyers toward the properties that best match their preferences. It gives the agency a single automated point of contact that never sleeps.

Behind the chat experience sits a complete CRM that keeps every lead and conversation organised. The system pairs a Python/Django backend and PostgreSQL with the Meta (WhatsApp) platform for messaging, uses OpenAI and Gemini models to understand and respond to client requests, leans on Airtable for operational data, and is hosted on AWS.

title: Externalize ERP System
description:
Designed and developed an AI-assisted accounting automation platform that streamlines the journey from invoice collection to ERP posting. The system uses OCR and large language models to extract structured data from invoices, generate draft accounting entries, and route them through a human validation workflow before synchronization with the accounting system. Multi-company support, role-based access control, audit trails, and secure document management ensure operational reliability and compliance.

The platform integrates with the Cegid ERP ecosystem to synchronize accounting and tax data, automate approved journal postings, and provide real-time visibility through financial dashboards, reporting tools, and intelligent alerts. Built with a strong focus on traceability and accounting control, the solution combines AI-driven efficiency with human oversight, helping accounting teams reduce manual workload while maintaining accuracy and compliance across financial operations.

title: Global Trading System - Automated Crypto Trading Platform
description:
Global Trading System (GTS) is an automated crypto-futures trading platform that turns your TradingView strategy signals into live trades on your exchange — no manual clicking required. Users connect their account, set their risk preferences, and GTS executes and tracks every position automatically.

The platform is built on a Python/Django backend with a JavaScript/Node.js and TailwindCSS frontend, backed by PostgreSQL and deployed on AWS, with Web3 integration as part of the crypto workflow. It continuously ingests incoming strategy signals and takes care of order execution and position tracking on the user's behalf.

title: Girudo - Online TCG Community & Streaming Platform
description:
Developed a community-driven platform for trading card game (TCG) enthusiasts that combines live streaming, social networking, and online gameplay into a single experience. The platform enables players to connect with fellow collectors and competitors, join live streams, participate in community discussions, discover content creators, and organize games through an integrated social ecosystem designed specifically for TCG communities.

Built with scalability and engagement in mind, the platform features creator profiles, community forums, video content hubs, live streaming capabilities, friend systems, and support for multiple card games including Magic: The Gathering and Disney Lorcana. The goal was to create a centralized destination where players can play, watch, learn, and interact with the broader TCG community while helping creators grow their audiences and strengthen community engagement.

title: Clinic AI Voice Agent for Scheduling, Intake & Specialist Routing
description:
This is an AI voice agent for a medical clinic that can schedule appointments, carry out patient intake, and route callers to the appropriate specialist. It takes on the routine phone work that would otherwise tie up front-desk staff, letting patients simply call in and speak naturally with the agent.

It combines a Python backend and PostgreSQL with a JavaScript/Node.js and TailwindCSS interface, and uses an OpenAI-based LLM for the conversation. VAPI and Twilio provide the real-time voice and telephony layer that powers the live phone calls.
liveUrlNote: Deployed privately for the client's clinic, so there is no public demo.

title: AI-Powered LinkedIn Automation & CRM Integration Platform
description:
This platform automates LinkedIn interactions and integrates them with your CRM to streamline sales and marketing efforts, cutting down the manual work involved in prospecting and relationship management on the network.

It follows a microservices design built across Python (FastAPI) and Go (Gin) services with a Nest.js component, backed by PostgreSQL and deployed on AWS. LLMs support its automation and content features, while web-scraping pipelines gather the LinkedIn data that feeds the CRM integration.

title: Entrepreneur's Business Simulator
description:
Entrepreneur's Business Simulator is a training platform designed to teach young entrepreneurs the fundamentals of business and financial management. Rather than dry theory, it lets learners practise decision-making in a simulated environment.

It is built with a Python/Django backend using Jinja2 server-side templating and a JavaScript frontend, with PostgreSQL storing the simulation and user data.

title: PractiCal Food Ordering System
description:
PractiCal is a nutritionist-led food-ordering system that helps customers receive meal plans tailored to their dietary needs. Instead of generic takeout, it focuses on delivering the right meals for each customer's goals and restrictions.

The application uses a PHP/Laravel backend with a Next.js and TailwindCSS frontend and a MySQL database, tying together ordering, meal-plan management, and delivery in one platform.

title: Go Bro On-Demand Service Booking Platform
description:
Go Bro is an on-demand service-booking platform where customers can request everyday help such as babysitting, plumbing, carpentry, and A/C repair, connecting them with providers for the service they need, when they need it.

It pairs a PHP/Laravel backend and MySQL database with a React Native mobile app (published on the Google Play Store) and Vite.js/Node.js tooling on the web side, delivering the booking experience across both mobile and web.

title: NFT Showroom
description:
NFT Showroom is a platform for showcasing digital assets that aims to make engaging with NFTs approachable and safe for everyone, not just crypto-natives. It puts a friendly front-end on what can otherwise be an intimidating space.

On-chain logic is written in Solidity and accessed through Web3.js and MetaMask, while a Python/Django and Django REST Framework backend with PostgreSQL serves the application's API. The client side is built with React Native and Vite.js/Node.js tooling.

title: ATS System - Resume Parser And Analytics System
description:
ATS Resume Parser is an internal tool for a hiring agency that parses incoming resumes and saves them to a database through an automated pipeline, removing the manual data-entry burden from recruiters. Beyond parsing, it lets recruiters semantically search and match or rank candidates against the roles they are hiring for.

It is built on a Python/FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL and a JavaScript/TailwindCSS interface, and uses OpenAI LLMs orchestrated with LangChain together with a vector database — both to extract structured fields from resumes and to power the AI-driven candidate search.

title: LawnPro Software
description:
LawnPro is business-management software for lawn-care companies, shipping with a range of features to manage employees, payments, customers, and the day-to-day operations of the business from a single place.

It is built on a PHP/Laravel backend and MySQL database, with a React.js frontend (Vite.js/Node.js tooling) providing the management interface.

title: Minecraft Server Discovery & Auction Platform
description:
This platform lets users discover Minecraft servers and buy or sell them through auctions. It brings server browsing and a real marketplace together, so owners can list their servers and interested buyers can bid on them.

It is built with a Python/Django backend and PostgreSQL, with a JavaScript frontend, and integrates Stripe to handle the real payments behind the auction transactions.

title: The Duck Council
description:
The Duck Council is a playful take on the classic 'rubber-duck debugging' technique: instead of explaining your problem to a single rubber duck, you bring it before a whole council. You describe a problem and the council reflects on it from multiple angles to help you think it through.

It uses CrewAI to orchestrate several AI agents that act as the council members and discuss the problem together. The backend is a Python/Flask service with MongoDB, and the frontend is built in React.js with Vite.js.

title: EtherPass - Decentralized Event Ticket Booking System
description:
EtherPass is a decentralized event ticket-booking system that lets users book tickets for events directly with their web3 wallet, using the blockchain to handle ticket ownership in a tamper-resistant way.

Its smart contracts are written in Solidity and developed with Truffle on Ethereum, accessed from the client via Web3.js and MetaMask. The application layer combines a React.js (Vite.js) frontend with a Nest.js backend and Turso DB.

title: Product Webscraper For E-commerce Site and Product Image Generator
description:
eBay Product Scraper is a tool that automatically collects product listings from eBay and saves them to a database, turning scattered marketplace data into a structured, queryable dataset.

It is built in Python with Django and uses Selenium to drive the scraping, persisting the results to PostgreSQL alongside a vector database, with a JavaScript/TailwindCSS interface on top.

title: CrowdGrid - Crowdfunding Decentralized App
description:
This is a crowdfunding solution built entirely on web3: creators can host their projects for funding in crypto and withdraw the raised funds whenever they need to, without a traditional payment intermediary sitting in the middle.

The frontend is built with React.js and Vite.js, connecting to wallets through MetaMask and Ethers.js, with Hedera Hashgraph as the underlying distributed ledger. A Nest.js backend with Turso DB supports the off-chain side of the app.

title: ExpenTable
description:
ExpenTable is an 'expendable' timetable built for quick weekly planning — simple to fill in, yet loaded with the small conveniences that make recurring scheduling pleasant to use.

It is a frontend-focused app built with React.js using Vite.js and Node.js tooling.

title: Cloud Munshi
description:
Cloud Munshi is point-of-sale (POS) software for business owners who want to keep track of their inventory and run their operations from a single tool — from recording sales to managing stock levels.

It is built on a PHP (Yii) backend with a Next.js frontend (Vite.js tooling) and a MySQL database.

title: Tkinter Mod Manager
description:
This is a simple mod manager built on Tkinter. The applet is named a mod manager because certain games let you add or remove mods by copying, pasting, or deleting files from one directory to another. Those mod files are often named in a non-human-friendly way (e.g. 1234567.mod), so while copying and pasting them between directories works, it becomes very hard to keep track of which files belong to which mod. This applet makes that task easy.

It is a lightweight desktop GUI tool written in Python with Tkinter, giving an approachable interface to what is otherwise tedious, error-prone manual file management.

title: Shell Show
description:
Shell Show is a command-line applet that can render images directly inside the terminal, bringing picture output to an environment that normally only deals in text.

It is written in Python and uses the Pillow imaging library to read and process images before translating them into terminal-friendly output.

title: Docker Practice/Tutorial Repo
description:
This is a repository collecting various Docker experiments — the things I have tried with Docker, each written up as a tutorial explaining how it works and why.

It centres on Docker with supporting Python and Shell scripting, and doubles as a published, hands-on tutorial resource for others learning containerisation.

title: Screen Magnifier - Teaching Assistance Tool
description:
Screen Magnifier is a desktop app for enlarging a portion of the screen — handy when you are presenting a lot of code and text and want to zoom into a specific area so your audience can follow along.

It is built in Python with a PyQt interface, using OpenCV and Pillow to capture and magnify the selected region of the screen in real time.

title: Python Dependency Report Generator
description:
This tool produces a .docx document that lists out all of the dependencies a given Python environment uses, turning a project's package list into a shareable, formatted report.

It is a small Python utility built around the python-docx library, which it uses to generate the Word-format output.

title: Usagi Chan's Number Guessing Game
description:
Usagi Chan's Number Guessing Game is a browser game where the player is shown a number and has to guess whether the next number will be larger or smaller. A correct guess earns a point, while a wrong one costs a life.

It is a frontend game built with React.js and Vite.js, and is playable live in the browser.

title: WebGL Fluid Simulation
description:
This is a small side project that simulates fluid effects directly on an HTML document, creating interactive, flowing visuals right in the browser.

It is built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, using WebGL to render the simulation with GPU acceleration.

title: Marketing Campaign EDA On Supermarket Dataset
description:
This project is an exploratory data analysis of a supermarket's marketing campaign, aiming to surface trends and patterns in how the campaign performed and who it reached.

The analysis is carried out in Python, using Pandas and NumPy for data wrangling, Seaborn for visualisation, and Scikit-learn and TensorFlow for the modelling and analytical work.

title: Exploratory Data Analysis Of Pokemon Data - 2022 Submission for DataDNA Challenge
description:
This is my submission for the 2022 DataDNA challenge hosted by OnyxData — an exploratory data analysis built around a Pokémon dataset, digging into the patterns hidden in the data.

It combines SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow) for the data work with Power BI for interactive visualisation and reporting.

title: Exploratory Data Analysis Of Hate Crimes In USA (1991-2020)
description:
This exploratory data analysis examines hate-crime records from across the USA between 1991 and 2020, working through three decades of data to extract meaningful insights and trends.

It uses SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow) to process and analyse the records, with Power BI used to visualise the findings.

title: TermaChat
description:
TermaChat is a command-line applet for peer-to-peer, serverless communication — letting two parties chat directly without routing their messages through a central server.

It is written in Python, using WebSockets for the connection and multithreading to handle sending and receiving messages concurrently.
